name: Valerius the Sun-Sworn
title: Sovereign Paladin
biography: Born under the zenith of the temporal sun, Valerius swore a blood-oath to defend the emerald walls of Crownspire from the wildling tundra legions. His golden solar shield has never cracked.
story_chapters: Chapter 1: The Blood-Oath of the Zenith
Chapter 2: Siege of the Iron Citadel

name: Aria Wind-Runner
title: Elven Ranger Core
biography: Whispering through the ancient branches of the Elderwood, Aria acts as the eyes of Crownspire. Her speed-bow strikes down enemies before they hear the release of her bowstring.

name: Kaelen the Chrono-Mage
title: Arch-Mage of Eternity
biography: An enigmatic scholar of chronal patterns, Kaelen manipulates historical loops to speed up sovereign construction projects and slow down invading tundra legions.
story_chapters: Chapter 1: The Broken Sands of Time
Chapter 3: Portal of the Sovereign Crown

name: Garrick Iron-Fist
title: Dwarven Vanguard Lord
biography: A rough and tumble master mason who loves dark dwarven ale and heavy volcanic steel warhammers. He personally rebuilt the outer ramparts during the Great Tundra Siege.
story_chapters: Chapter 2: Hammer of the Mountain King
